clips.title: The story
paras: At Bael Modan, Sodium Nitrate helps the dwarves blast through the southern Barrens’ stone. Gann Stonespire seeks the chemical for charges against the fortress.

Dwarven excavators at Bael Modan use Sodium Nitrate to break through the southern Barrens’ rock. The Bael'dun expedition entered the Stonespire tribe’s ancestral lands with earthmovers and blasting reagents. Riflemen, soldiers, and officers carry the chemical inside the excavation works and nearby fortress.
